name: Mirror
source:
Your window is a mirror to another world -- and another you.

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 30[/url] (theme: Connected Worlds).
translation:
你的窗户是一面镜子，照出另一个世界——也是另一个你。

为 [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 30[/url] 创建（主题：互联世界）。
